Name: Zechariah, Son of Jehoshaphat
Summary: Zechariah was a son of Jehoshaphat who received great gifts from his father and was slain by his brother Jehoram when he took the kingdom.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat's sons, including Zechariah, were slain by Jehoram with the sword after he strengthened himself.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Jehoram, King of Judah
LifeLesson: A godly father's sons can still fall to a brother's ambition.
